summary: XMax Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an October 5, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Hexa Creation Inc. from Professor Yuji Zhao (970 shares, 97%) and Skysong Innovations (30 shares, 3%) for an aggregate $4,123,711.34, split $4,000,000 and $123,711.34. Consideration is cash in two tranches: $2,061,855.67 at closing (net of a $500,000 June 24, 2026 deposit) and $2,061,855.67 deferred to December 31, 2027, bearing interest at not less than the applicable federal rate. Hexa shares are pledged as collateral until deferred amounts are paid; a 5% change-of-control payment to patent licensor Skysong is due within 30 days of closing. Watch closing conditions, the exclusive license remaining in force, and financing of the deferred payment.
